title.zh: CLARITY Act faces state AGs opposition ahead of key Senate vote
title.en: CLARITY Act faces state AGs opposition ahead of key Senate vote

current_state.zh: The CLARITY Act heads toward a key Senate procedural vote after Trump's ethics concession, but 18 state attorneys general led by New York's Letitia James are urging rejection, arguing the bill would weaken state oversight of crypto firms.
current_state.en: The CLARITY Act heads toward a key Senate procedural vote after Trump's ethics concession, but 18 state attorneys general led by New York's Letitia James are urging rejection, arguing the bill would weaken state oversight of crypto firms.
